findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.lookup' class Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetLookUp differs in letter case from the real file src/WidgetLookup.php: the autoloader fails on case-sensitive filesystems (Linux servers, DDEV).
findings.suggestion: Use the exact class name: Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetLookup.

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.legacy_exporter' points at class Drupal\legacy_widgets\Export\LegacyExporter, but src/Export/LegacyExporter.php does not exist (orphan service): fetching it is a fatal error.
findings.suggestion: Remove the service definition, or restore/rename the class.

findings.message: Config 'legacy_widgets.settings' has no schema in config/schema/*.schema.yml: strict config schema checks (Kernel/Functional tests, config inspector) fail on it and its values are not typed or translatable.
findings.suggestion: Add a 'legacy_widgets.settings:' entry (type: config_object for simple config) to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml.

findings.message: configure: 'legacy_widgets.settings' names a route that no *.routing.yml of the extension defines: core drops the Configure link from /admin/modules silently (unless a route subscriber or another module provides it).
findings.suggestion: Point it at the real route ('legacy_widgets.settings_form'?).

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.counter' passes 3 argument(s) but Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetCounter::__construct() takes 2: PHP silently ignores the extra one(s) (a stale argument, or a constructor that lost a parameter).
findings.suggestion: Drop the extra argument(s), or restore the constructor parameter they were meant for.

findings.message: Condition plugin 'legacy_widgets_enabled' has its own settings but no 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled' schema: only core's generic 'condition.plugin.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: Filter plugin 'legacy_widgets_summary' has its own settings but no 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary' schema: only core's generic 'filter_settings.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: Submodule 'legacy_widgets_extra' declares core_version_requirement: ^8.8 || ^9 || ^10, which does not admit Drupal 11: core marks it incompatible and it cannot be installed.
findings.suggestion: Set it to the parent's constraint ('^10'): /drupilot-port does this with set-core-requirement.sh.

findings.message: 'legacy_widgets_extra' uses project module 'legacy_widgets' (class,service) without declaring it in legacy_widgets_extra.info.yml dependencies: installing 'legacy_widgets_extra' alone fails or breaks at runtime.
'legacy_widgets_extra' uses core module 'node' (class) without declaring it in legacy_widgets_extra.info.yml dependencies: installing 'legacy_widgets_extra' alone fails or breaks at runtime.
